sentences.en: I saw two guys kissing each other in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 我在走廊里看见两个男生在接吻。

sentences.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 这条走廊需要足够宽才能容纳轮椅。

sentences.en: My teacher was in the hallway, talking to another teacher.
sentences.zh: 我的老师正在走廊上和其他老师交谈。
